```{r setup, include=FALSE}
required_packages <- c("dplyr", "readr", "tidyr", "stringr", "purrr", "tibble", "ggplot2", "scales", "knitr")
missing_packages <- required_packages[!vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly=TRUE)]
if (length(missing_packages)) stop("Missing packages: ", paste(missing_packages, collapse=", "))
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(readr); library(tidyr); library(stringr)
  library(purrr); library(tibble); library(ggplot2); library(scales); library(knitr)
})
options(dplyr.summarise.inform=FALSE, scipen=999)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.align="center")

thesis_root <- normalizePath(getwd(), winslash="/", mustWork=TRUE)
model_output_dir <- file.path(thesis_root, "Methodology", "outputs")
exhibit_dir <- file.path(thesis_root, "outputs", "dissertation_exhibits")
figure_dir <- file.path(exhibit_dir, "figures")
table_dir <- file.path(exhibit_dir, "tables")
if (!dir.exists(model_output_dir)) stop("Model outputs not found at ", model_output_dir,
  ". Knit from the Thesis Draft working directory.")
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive=TRUE, showWarnings=FALSE)
dir.create(table_dir, recursive=TRUE, showWarnings=FALSE)

resolve_file <- function(primary, required=TRUE) {
  relative <- sub("^outputs/", "", primary)
  path <- file.path(model_output_dir, relative)
  if (file.exists(path)) return(normalizePath(path, winslash="/", mustWork=TRUE))
  if (!required) return(NA_character_)
  stop("Missing frozen input: ", path, call.=FALSE)
}
read_csv_safe <- function(path) {
  if (length(path)==0 || is.na(path) || !file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types=FALSE)
}
validate_cols <- function(x, required, label) {
  missing <- setdiff(required, names(x))
  if(length(missing)) stop(label, " missing columns: ", paste(missing, collapse=", "), call.=FALSE)
}
fmt_pct <- function(x, accuracy=0.01) scales::percent(x, accuracy=accuracy, scale=100)
fmt_pp <- function(x) paste0(formatC(100*x, format="f", digits=2), " pp")
fmt_num <- function(x, digits=3) formatC(x, format="f", digits=digits, big.mark=",")
fmt_currency <- function(x, digits=0) scales::dollar(x, accuracy=10^(-digits), big.mark=",")
fmt_yes_no <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", ifelse(x, "Yes", "No"))
metric_value <- function(df, key, numeric=TRUE) {
  ix <- which(df$metric==key)
  if (!length(ix)) return(if(numeric) NA_real_ else NA_character_)
  value <- df$value[[ix[[1]]]]
  if(numeric) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(value)) else as.character(value)
}

figure_colours <- c(
  navy="#17465F", teal="#16827C", orange="#CE7940",
  grey="#677985", charcoal="#202D36", light="#D9E1E6"
)
theme_dissertation <- function(base_size=11.5) {
  ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size=base_size, base_family="serif") +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title=element_blank(), plot.subtitle=element_blank(),
      plot.caption=element_blank(),
      plot.background=element_rect(fill="white", colour=NA),
      panel.background=element_rect(fill="white", colour=NA),
      panel.border=element_rect(fill=NA, colour="#A8B4BC", linewidth=.3),
      panel.grid.major.x=element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y=element_line(colour="#E5EBEF", linewidth=.28),
      panel.grid.minor=element_blank(),
      axis.title=element_text(face="bold", colour=figure_colours[["charcoal"]], size=base_size),
      axis.text=element_text(colour=figure_colours[["charcoal"]], size=base_size-1),
      axis.ticks=element_line(colour="#5D6971", linewidth=.3),
      strip.background=element_rect(fill="white", colour="#C6CDD2", linewidth=.35),
      strip.text=element_text(face="bold", colour=figure_colours[["charcoal"]], size=base_size-1),
      legend.position="bottom", legend.title=element_blank(),
      legend.text=element_text(size=base_size-1),
      legend.key=element_blank(),
      plot.margin=margin(8,12,8,10)
    )
}

save_figure <- function(plot, filename, width, height) {
  pdf_path <- file.path(figure_dir, paste0(filename, ".pdf"))
  png_path <- file.path(figure_dir, paste0(filename, ".png"))
  ggplot2::ggsave(pdf_path, plot=plot, width=width, height=height, units="in",
      device=if (capabilities("cairo")) grDevices::cairo_pdf else "pdf", bg="white")
  ggplot2::ggsave(png_path, plot=plot, width=width, height=height, units="in", dpi=400, bg="white")
  invisible(c(pdf=pdf_path,png=png_path))
}
save_table <- function(dat, filename, caption, longtable=FALSE) {
  csv_path <- file.path(table_dir, paste0(filename, ".csv"))
  tex_path <- file.path(table_dir, paste0(filename, ".tex"))
  readr::write_csv(dat, csv_path)
  tex <- knitr::kable(dat, format="latex", booktabs=TRUE,
                       longtable=longtable, caption=caption, escape=TRUE, linesep="")
  writeLines(as.character(tex), tex_path)
  invisible(c(csv=csv_path, tex=tex_path))
}

resolve_complete <- function(input, numeric_cols, label) {
  dat <- read_csv_safe(resolve_file(input))
  validate_cols(dat, numeric_cols, label)
  successes <- if("collection_success" %in% names(dat))
    sum(dat$collection_success %in% TRUE) else nrow(dat)
  if(nrow(dat)<10 || successes<10 || sum(complete.cases(dat[,numeric_cols,drop=FALSE]))<10)
    stop(label, " does not contain ten completed observations.")
  dat
}

select_frozen_folder <- function(candidates, required_files, label) {
  valid <- vapply(candidates, function(folder) {
    all(file.exists(file.path(model_output_dir, folder, required_files)))
  }, logical(1))
  if (!any(valid)) stop("No complete ", label, " snapshot found in: ",
                        paste(candidates, collapse=", "), call.=FALSE)
  chosen <- candidates[which(valid)[1]]
  message(label, " input folder: ", chosen)
  chosen
}
pricing_folder <- select_frozen_folder(
 c("pricing_simulation_v3","pricing_simulation"),
 c("targeted_segmentation_comparison.csv","selected_segment_multipliers.csv",
   "test_strategy_comparison.csv"), "Pricing")

paths <- list(
  truth_rds=resolve_file("outputs/synthetic_generator_multiyear/synthetic_motor_full_truth.rds", FALSE),

  conversion_by_rank=resolve_file("outputs/conversion_generation/conversion_by_rank.csv"),
  validation_metrics=resolve_file("outputs/conversion_models/validation_model_metrics.csv"),
  truth_recovery=resolve_file("outputs/conversion_models/truth_probability_recovery.csv"),
  target_comparison=resolve_file(file.path("outputs",pricing_folder,"targeted_segmentation_comparison.csv")),
  selected_multipliers=resolve_file(file.path("outputs",pricing_folder,"selected_segment_multipliers.csv")),
  test_strategy=resolve_file(file.path("outputs",pricing_folder,"test_strategy_comparison.csv")),
  bootstrap_summary=resolve_file("outputs/pricing_bootstrap_uncertainty/paired_bootstrap_summary.csv", FALSE),
  bootstrap_replications=resolve_file("outputs/pricing_bootstrap_uncertainty/paired_bootstrap_replications.csv", FALSE)
)
technical_profiles <- read_csv_safe(paths$technical_profiles)
technical_summary <- read_csv_safe(paths$technical_summary)
technical_truth_summary <- read_csv_safe(paths$technical_truth_summary)
quote_summary <- read_csv_safe(paths$quote_summary)

selected_multipliers <- read_csv_safe(paths$selected_multipliers)

bootstrap_replications <- read_csv_safe(paths$bootstrap_replications)
# Include bootstrap exhibits only after confirming the 10,000-profile rerun.
# Explicitly reject a stale 2,000-profile bootstrap, even if filenames are the same.
bootstrap_checks <- read_csv_safe(resolve_file(
  "outputs/pricing_bootstrap_uncertainty/paired_bootstrap_validation_checks.csv", FALSE))
run_bootstrap_exhibits <- !is.null(bootstrap_summary) &&
  !is.null(bootstrap_replications) && !is.null(bootstrap_checks)
if (!run_bootstrap_exhibits) {
  stop("New Module 06B bootstrap files are required: point estimates, ",
       "summary, replications and validation checks in ",
       "Methodology/outputs/pricing_bootstrap_uncertainty. Do not reuse 2,000-profile results.")
}
stopifnot(
  nrow(bootstrap_replications) == 5000L,
  all(c("check_name", "observed_value", "pass") %in% names(bootstrap_checks)),
  all(bootstrap_checks$pass %in% TRUE),
  any(bootstrap_checks$check_name == "Paired TEST profiles" &
      as.numeric(bootstrap_checks$observed_value) == 10000),
  any(bootstrap_checks$check_name == "Bootstrap replications" &
      as.numeric(bootstrap_checks$observed_value) == 5000),
  all(c("absolute_true_conversion_uplift", "relative_true_conversion_uplift",
        "true_margin_retention") %in% bootstrap_summary$metric)
)
sensitivity <- resolve_complete(file.path("outputs",sensitivity_folder,"sensitivity_summary.csv"),
 c("targeted_true_relative_conversion_uplift","targeted_true_margin_retention"), "Sensitivity")
monte_carlo <- resolve_complete(file.path("outputs",monte_carlo_folder,"monte_carlo_replication_summary.csv"),
 c("targeted_true_relative_conversion_uplift","targeted_true_margin_retention"), "Monte Carlo")
```

## Table 8 — Conversion model performance
```{r table-conversion-performance}
model_order <- c("Technical-only GLM","Own-price GLM","Rank GLM",
 "Relative-price GLM","Market-position GLM","Market-position GAM")
validation_final <- validation_metrics
if("data_split" %in% names(validation_final))
 validation_final <- filter(validation_final,data_split=="validation")
validate_cols(validation_final,c("model","log_loss","auc","calibration_slope"),"Validation model metrics")
validate_cols(truth_recovery,c("model","probability_spearman_correlation","probability_mae","probability_rmse"),"Truth recovery")
table_08_conversion_performance <- validation_final %>%
 select(model,log_loss,auc,calibration_slope) %>%
 left_join(truth_recovery %>% select(model,probability_spearman_correlation,
                                  probability_mae,probability_rmse),by="model") %>%
 mutate(model=factor(model,levels=model_order)) %>% arrange(model) %>%
 transmute(Model=as.character(model),
 `Validation log loss`=sprintf("%.4f",log_loss),
 `Validation AUC`=sprintf("%.3f",auc),
 `Validation calibration slope`=sprintf("%.3f",calibration_slope),
 `Test underlying Spearman`=sprintf("%.3f",probability_spearman_correlation),
 `Test probability MAE`=sprintf("%.4f",probability_mae))
save_table(table_08_conversion_performance,"table_08_conversion_model_performance",
 "Validation performance and independent test-sample recovery of underlying conversion probabilities.")
knitr::kable(table_08_conversion_performance)
```

```{r table-monte-carlo-summary}
 mean(monte_carlo$targeted_true_relative_conversion_uplift,na.rm=TRUE),
 mean(monte_carlo$targeted_true_margin_retention,na.rm=TRUE),
 mean(monte_carlo$targeted_test_rate_level,na.rm=TRUE),
 mean(monte_carlo$targeted_true_claim_ratio,na.rm=TRUE)),
 maximum=c(max(monte_carlo$selected_relative_log_loss_improvement_vs_own_price,na.rm=TRUE),
 max(monte_carlo$truth_recovery_spearman_gain,na.rm=TRUE),
 max(monte_carlo$targeted_true_relative_conversion_uplift,na.rm=TRUE),
 max(monte_carlo$targeted_true_margin_retention,na.rm=TRUE),
 max(monte_carlo$targeted_test_rate_level,na.rm=TRUE),
 max(monte_carlo$targeted_true_claim_ratio,na.rm=TRUE)),
 format_type=c("pct","raw","pct","pct","pct","pct")) %>%
 rowwise() %>% mutate(
 Minimum=if_else(format_type=="raw",sprintf("%.3f",minimum),fmt_pct(minimum)),
 Mean=if_else(format_type=="raw",sprintf("%.3f",average),fmt_pct(average)),
 Maximum=if_else(format_type=="raw",sprintf("%.3f",maximum),fmt_pct(maximum))) %>%
 ungroup() %>% select(Measure,Minimum,Mean,Maximum)
save_table(mc_summary,"table_A1_monte_carlo_stability_summary",
 "Range and mean of principal outcomes across ten Monte Carlo replications.")
knitr::kable(mc_summary)
```

```{r figure-architecture, fig.width=11, fig.height=3.6}
architecture_route <- function(xs, ys, channel="main") {
  stopifnot(length(xs) == length(ys), length(xs) >= 2L)
  n <- length(xs) - 1L
  tibble::tibble(
    x = xs[seq_len(n)], y = ys[seq_len(n)],
    xend = xs[seq_len(n) + 1L], yend = ys[seq_len(n) + 1L],
    channel = channel,
    final_segment = seq_len(n) == n
  )
}
```

## Figure 6 source — Structural sensitivity (Figure 7 in report after pricing comparison)
```{r figure-sensitivity-map}
sensitivity_plot <- sensitivity %>%
  mutate(
    Scenario = recode(case_id, !!!scenario_labels, .default = case_id),
    uplift_pct = 100 * targeted_true_relative_conversion_uplift,
    retention_pct = 100 * targeted_true_margin_retention
  )

# Baseline and strict adequacy have identical coordinates in the 250,000-policy
# experiment. Use one shared label to avoid two labels competing for one point.
baseline_point <- sensitivity_plot %>% filter(case_id == "baseline")
strict_point <- sensitivity_plot %>% filter(case_id == "pricing_strict_adequacy")
coincident_baseline_strict <- (
  nrow(baseline_point) == 1L && nrow(strict_point) == 1L &&
  abs(baseline_point$uplift_pct - strict_point$uplift_pct) < 1e-8 &&
  abs(baseline_point$retention_pct - strict_point$retention_pct) < 1e-8
)

# Fixed text offsets are deliberate: this avoids automatic label repulsion
# placing text on the horizontal 100% benchmark or overlapping close points.
# The plotted coordinates, scenario results and benchmark lines are unchanged.
sensitivity_labels <- sensitivity_plot %>%
  mutate(
    display_label = case_when(
      case_id == "baseline" & coincident_baseline_strict ~
        "Baseline /\nStrict adequacy",
      case_id == "pricing_strict_adequacy" & coincident_baseline_strict ~
        NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ Scenario
    ),
    dx = case_when(
      case_id == "baseline" ~ 3.25,
      case_id == "pricing_strict_adequacy" ~ -2.0,
      case_id == "market_high_competition" ~ -0.9,
      case_id == "market_low_competition" ~ 1.6,
      case_id == "market_fragmented" ~ -1.5,
      case_id == "demand_low_price_sensitivity" ~ 2.2,
      case_id == "demand_agentic" ~ -2.0,
      case_id == "demand_threshold" ~ -1.2,
      case_id == "pricing_narrow_support" ~ 0.7,
      case_id == "pricing_wide_stress" ~ 2.2,
      TRUE ~ 0.8
    ),
    dy = case_when(
      case_id == "baseline" ~ -0.78,
      case_id == "pricing_strict_adequacy" ~ -1.05,
      case_id == "market_high_competition" ~ 0.75,
      case_id == "market_low_competition" ~ 0.84,
      case_id == "market_fragmented" ~ -0.72,
      case_id == "demand_low_price_sensitivity" ~ 0.92,
      case_id == "demand_agentic" ~ -0.70,
      case_id == "demand_threshold" ~ 0.62,
      case_id == "pricing_narrow_support" ~ -1.13,
      case_id == "pricing_wide_stress" ~ 0.45,
      TRUE ~ 0.6
    ),
    label_x = uplift_pct + dx,
    label_y = retention_pct + dy
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(display_label))

p_sensitivity <- ggplot(sensitivity_plot, aes(x = uplift_pct, y = retention_pct)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = .6,
             colour = figure_colours[["grey"]]) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = .6,
             colour = figure_colours[["grey"]]) +
  # Draw fine leader lines first, so points and text remain unobstructed.
  geom_segment(
    data = sensitivity_labels,
    aes(x = uplift_pct, y = retention_pct, xend = label_x, yend = label_y),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = .33,
    colour = "#9DAFB9"
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = pricing_conclusion_stable,
                 colour = pricing_conclusion_stable), size = 3.3, stroke = .8) +
  # White, borderless backgrounds prevent dashed grid/reference lines from
  # running through the labels (particularly Low price sensitivity).
  geom_label(
    data = sensitivity_labels,
    aes(x = label_x, y = label_y, label = display_label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3.25, family = "serif",
    colour = figure_colours[["charcoal"]], fill = "white",
    label.size = 0, label.padding = grid::unit(.09, "lines")
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(`TRUE` = figure_colours[["teal"]],
               `FALSE` = figure_colours[["orange"]]), guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 16, `FALSE` = 4), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 35, 5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(100, 112, 2)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1.5, 35.0), ylim = c(99.1, 112.1)) +
  labs(x = "Relative conversion uplift under simulated demand (%)",
       y = "Expected profit retention under simulated demand (%)") +
  theme_dissertation()

save_figure(p_sensitivity, "fig_06_sensitivity_decision_map", 9.1, 6.2)
p_sensitivity
```

```{r figure-pricing-comparison}
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values=c("Technical benchmark"=figure_colours[["navy"]],
                                      "Targeted strategy"=figure_colours[["teal"]])) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) {
    if (max(abs(x), na.rm = TRUE) > 10000) {
      ifelse(x == 0, "$0", paste0("$", scales::comma(x / 1000), "k"))
    } else {scales::comma(x)}},
  expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, .22))) +
  ggplot2::labs(x=NULL,y=NULL) + theme_dissertation(11) +
  ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x=ggplot2::element_text(size=9),
                 legend.position="none", panel.grid.major.y=ggplot2::element_line(colour="#E5EBEF"))
save_figure(p_pricing, "fig_09_test_pricing_comparison", 9.2, 4.1)
p_pricing
```

## Figure 10 — NEW (optional): Seven-insurer initial quote market
```{r figure-seven-insurers}
truth_path <- resolve_file("outputs/conversion_generation/conversion_truth.rds", FALSE)
alt_path <- resolve_file("outputs/conversion_generation/conversion_alternative_truth.rds", FALSE)
if (!is.na(truth_path) && !is.na(alt_path)) {
  profile_truth <- readRDS(truth_path)
  alternative_truth <- readRDS(alt_path)
  validate_cols(profile_truth,
                c("policy_id", "quote_profile_id", "true_market_purchase_probability"),
                "Conversion truth")
  validate_cols(alternative_truth,
                c("policy_id", "quote_profile_id", "alternative_id",
                  "alternative_quote", "true_conditional_choice_probability", "is_focal"),
                "Alternative truth")

  profiles <- profile_truth %>%
    distinct(policy_id, quote_profile_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    select(policy_id, quote_profile_id, true_market_purchase_probability)
  n_profiles <- nrow(profiles)

  choices <- alternative_truth %>%
    inner_join(profiles, by = c("policy_id", "quote_profile_id")) %>%
    mutate(
      insurer = if_else(as.logical(is_focal), "Reference insurer",
                        paste0("Competitor ", alternative_id)),
      kind = if_else(as.logical(is_focal), "Reference insurer", "Competitors"),
      unconditional_purchase = true_market_purchase_probability *
        true_conditional_choice_probability
    )

  prob_check <- choices %>%
    group_by(policy_id, quote_profile_id) %>%
    summarise(prob = sum(true_conditional_choice_probability), .groups = "drop")
  if (nrow(prob_check) != n_profiles || any(abs(prob_check$prob - 1) > 1e-8)) {
    stop("Seven-insurer conditional choice probabilities do not reconcile.")
  }

  summary_insurer <- choices %>%
    group_by(insurer, kind) %>%
    summarise(
      returned_quotes = n(),
      q10 = as.numeric(quantile(alternative_quote, 0.10)),
      q25 = as.numeric(quantile(alternative_quote, 0.25)),
      median_quote = median(alternative_quote),
      q75 = as.numeric(quantile(alternative_quote, 0.75)),
      q90 = as.numeric(quantile(alternative_quote, 0.90)),
      expected_purchase_share = sum(unconditional_purchase) / n_profiles,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(kind == "Reference insurer"), insurer) %>%
    mutate(insurer = factor(insurer, levels = insurer),
           is_reference = kind == "Reference insurer")

  if (nrow(summary_insurer) != 7 ||
      abs(sum(summary_insurer$expected_purchase_share) -
          mean(profiles$true_market_purchase_probability)) > 1e-8) {
    stop("Seven-insurer participation reconciliation failed.")
  }

  readr::write_csv(summary_insurer,
                   file.path(figure_dir, "fig_10_seven_insurer_summary.csv"))

  insurer_palette <- c(
    "Reference insurer" = figure_colours[["navy"]],
    "Competitors" = "#9AAAB8"
  )
  insurer_labels <- function(x) {
    ifelse(x == "Reference insurer", "Reference\ninsurer",
           sub("^Competitor ", "Competitor\n", x))
  }

  summary_insurer <- summary_insurer %>%
    mutate(median_label_y = median_quote + pmin(
      0.38 * (q75 - median_quote), 0.18 * (q75 - q25)
    ))
  pa <- ggplot(summary_insurer, aes(x = insurer, fill = kind)) +
    geom_boxplot(
      aes(ymin = q10, lower = q25, middle = median_quote,
          upper = q75, ymax = q90),
      stat = "identity", width = .58, linewidth = .65,
      colour = figure_colours[["charcoal"]], alpha = .70,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_label(aes(y = median_label_y,
                   label = scales::dollar(median_quote, accuracy = 1)),
               size = 2.55, family = "serif", fontface = "plain",
               fill = "NA", alpha = .96,
               label.size = 0, label.padding = grid::unit(.035, "lines"),
               colour = figure_colours[["charcoal"]], show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = insurer_palette) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = insurer_labels) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_dollar(accuracy = 1),
                       breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 4),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(.04, .06))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Quoted premium ($)") +
    theme_dissertation(11.0) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = .5,
                                     lineheight = .94, size = 8.35),
          axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 8)),
          legend.position = "none",
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())

  pb <- ggplot(summary_insurer,
               aes(x = insurer, y = expected_purchase_share, fill = kind)) +
    geom_col(width = .61, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(expected_purchase_share,
                                         accuracy = .1)),
              vjust = -.5, size = 3.0, family = "serif",
              colour = figure_colours[["charcoal"]], show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = insurer_palette) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = insurer_labels) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .22))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Expected purchase share (%)") +
    theme_dissertation(11.0) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = .5,
                                     lineheight = .94, size = 8.35),
          axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 8)),
          legend.position = "none",
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())

  if (requireNamespace("patchwork", quietly = TRUE)) {
    p_insurer <- pa / pb + patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1))
    save_figure(p_insurer, "fig_10_seven_insurer_comparison", 7.8, 5.3)
    p_insurer
  } else {
    warning("Figure 10 requires optional package patchwork; no files were written.")
  }
} else {
  warning("Figure 10 skipped: optional Module 04 alternative-truth RDS files unavailable.")
}
```

## Figure 11 — NEW (optional): Fitted technical-pricing relativities for Appendix C
```{r figure-fitted-relativities}
freq_path <- resolve_file("outputs/technical_pricing/final_frequency_model.rds",FALSE)
sev_path <- resolve_file("outputs/technical_pricing/final_severity_model.rds",FALSE)
modelling_path <- resolve_file("outputs/synthetic_generator_multiyear/synthetic_motor_modelling.csv",FALSE)
if(!is.na(freq_path) && !is.na(sev_path) && !is.na(modelling_path)) {
 freq_model <- readRDS(freq_path)
 sev_model <- readRDS(sev_path)
 raw <- read_csv_safe(modelling_path) %>% filter(policy_year<=2024)
 validate_cols(raw,c("driver_age","licence_years","annual_km","vehicle_value","vehicle_age",
  "voluntary_excess","prior_claims_5yr","exposure"),"Technical model development data")
 raw <- raw %>% mutate(
  prior_claims_band=factor(case_when(prior_claims_5yr<=0~"0",prior_claims_5yr==1~"1",
   prior_claims_5yr==2~"2",prior_claims_5yr==3~"3",TRUE~"4+"),
   levels=c("0","1","2","3","4+")),
  excess_factor=factor(voluntary_excess),
  log_annual_km=log(pmax(annual_km,1)),
  log_vehicle_value=log(pmax(vehicle_value,1)))
 for(k in c("state","remoteness_area","vehicle_segment","motive_power","transmission"))
  if(k %in% names(raw)) raw[[k]] <- factor(raw[[k]])
 anchor <- raw %>% filter(complete.cases(driver_age,licence_years,annual_km,
                          vehicle_value,vehicle_age)) %>%
  mutate(distance=abs(driver_age-median(driver_age))/25+
    abs(log_annual_km-median(log_annual_km))+
    abs(log_vehicle_value-median(log_vehicle_value))) %>%
  arrange(distance) %>% slice(1) %>% select(-distance)
 if(nrow(anchor)!=1) stop("No valid representative technical-pricing profile available")
 for(k in names(freq_model$xlevels))
  if(k %in% names(anchor)) anchor[[k]] <- factor(as.character(anchor[[k]]),
                                                levels=freq_model$xlevels[[k]])
 for(k in names(sev_model$xlevels))
  if(k %in% names(anchor)) anchor[[k]] <- factor(as.character(anchor[[k]]),
                                                levels=sev_model$xlevels[[k]])
 make_effect <- function(model,variable,values,outcome,label) {
  pred <- function(v) {
   newdata <- anchor[rep(1,length(v)),,drop=FALSE]
   newdata[[variable]] <- v
   if(variable=="annual_km") newdata$log_annual_km <- log(pmax(v,1))
   if(variable=="vehicle_value") newdata$log_vehicle_value <- log(pmax(v,1))
   as.numeric(predict(model,newdata=newdata,type="response"))
  }
  ref <- pred(anchor[[variable]])[[1]]
  tibble(metric=label,x=values,relativity=pred(values)/ref,
         outcome=outcome,reference_value=as.numeric(anchor[[variable]]))
 }
 qseq <- function(x) seq(as.numeric(quantile(x,.05,na.rm=TRUE)),
                          as.numeric(quantile(x,.95,na.rm=TRUE)),length.out=55)
 relative_effects <- bind_rows(
  make_effect(freq_model,"driver_age",qseq(raw$driver_age),"Paid-claim frequency","Driver age (years)"),
  make_effect(freq_model,"annual_km",qseq(raw$annual_km),"Paid-claim frequency","Annual kilometres (km)"),
  make_effect(sev_model,"vehicle_value",qseq(raw$vehicle_value),"Paid-claim severity","Vehicle value ($)"))
 if(any(!is.finite(relative_effects$relativity))) stop("Invalid fitted relativities")
 readr::write_csv(relative_effects,file.path(figure_dir,"fig_11_fitted_relativities_data.csv"))
 readr::write_csv(anchor,file.path(figure_dir,"fig_11_fitted_relativities_reference_profile.csv"))
 p_effects <- ggplot(relative_effects,aes(x=x,y=relativity,colour=outcome)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=1,linetype="dashed",linewidth=.6,
             colour=figure_colours[["grey"]]) +
  geom_line(linewidth=1.15) +
  facet_wrap(~metric,scales="free_x",ncol=2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values=c("Paid-claim frequency"=figure_colours[["navy"]],
                               "Paid-claim severity"=figure_colours[["orange"]])) +
  labs(x="Rating characteristic (panel-specific units)",
       y="Fitted relativity (reference profile = 1.00)") + theme_dissertation()
 save_figure(p_effects,"fig_11_fitted_technical_relativities",9.3,7.5)
 p_effects
} else warning("Figure 11 skipped: saved technical model objects or development file missing.")
```
